correctness.rationale: PASS: RESULT.md counts connected edge-selected subgraphs through any two distinct leaf indices via their unique cycle path (or spanning path/full cycle), with a_j(d)=2j-n+max(d-j,0)+max(n-d-j,0) allowable j-vertex arcs. Optional other leaf edges contribute 2^(j-2), and the n spanning paths plus cycle contribute (n+1)2^(n-2). The a_j(d) expression decreases strictly toward antipodal cyclic distance, giving unique minimizing index distance. Evaluating even and odd geometric sums gives L_n, while same-index and diagonal T_n=(2n-1)2^(n-1)+1>2L_n remove alternate minima. Core/leaf endpoint factors are 2 and 4 for distinct indices, with the stated minimum. Independent exhaustive edge-subgraph connectivity enumeration for n=3..7 confirmed leaf/core minima, ES=81,288,930,2736,7644 and every antipodal witness. The path counting, not the finite enumeration, supplies general n.
